name: Taiko SGX attestation accepts DEBUG-mode enclaves
summary: Taiko's AutomataDcapV3Attestation checked an application enclave quote's MRENCLAVE and MRSIGNER but never its attributes, so a DEBUG-mode enclave passed SgxVerifier.registerInstance. The attacker re-signed the trusted Raiko enclave with the MRSIGNER key that had been committed to the public raiko repository, ran it in DEBUG mode, and registered instances in both the SGX-GETH and SGX-RETH verifiers. The debug-readable instance keys then signed forged proofs, the Inbox saved forged L2 checkpoints, and forged bridge messages drained ETH and ERC-20s from the L1 Bridge and ERC20Vault.

loss.notes: Exact L1 depletion of the Taiko Bridge (native ETH) and ERC20Vault (ERC-20 Transfer logs) caused by forged messages across 36 transactions, including 18 ETH taken as the processing fee by 0xc0ffeebabe while it front-ran the forged message 9000. Each asset is valued at its DefiLlama price nearest its first release. The reported DefiLlama figure is $1.7M (source-12). Recoveries are not deducted.

ageReset.description: The SGX-GETH attestation proxy's creation receipt emitted its only Upgraded event, selecting AutomataDcapV3Attestation 0x5e46443bd131eb6d4c6fb4849bad29af9596dd72, which stayed active with an unchanged runtime through the exploit.
Upgraded event selecting AutomataDcapV3Attestation 0x5f73f0adc7daa6134fe751c4a78d524f9384e0b5, the SGX-RETH attestation implementation active through the exploit.

limitations: Same missing local-report attribute check in the SGX-RETH attestation; both SGX sub-proofs were needed, and target-1's later activation supplies the knot.

sources.note: Anchor: source-1 (block 25367938, index 1, from EOA 0x7506dea0c38ca0b55364b22424374c5a1ae1b76a to its contract 0xe0df6fc36deb38dd11dc53d327475c2b2b0ab98a, created at index 0 of the same block by 0x2c8160cd...). debug_traceTransaction(callTracer): top-level calls 1-2 are registerInstance (0xa91951a2) on SgxVerifier sgxGeth 0x08568df252ecf37d6c3efd24f6ca3688118697f1 and sgxReth 0xa1018ba2e22139076f91da2a856b2cab22d968f6 (MainnetVerifier 0x9caa4948381590900fcdd8a4f06eb24138ed665d sgxGethVerifier()/sgxRethVerifier()); each SgxVerifier calls verifyParsedQuote (0x089a168f) on its immutable automataDcapAttestation, proxy 0x0ffa4a625ed9db32b70f99180fd00759fc3e9261 (impl 0x5e46443b...) and proxy 0x8d7c954960a36a7596d7ea4945ddf891967ca8a3 (impl 0x5f73f0ad...). Decoding both calldatas as ParsedV3QuoteStruct: localEnclaveReport.attributes = 0x07000000000000000700000000000000 (flags INIT|DEBUG|MODE64BIT; DEBUG = bit 1), mrSigner 0xca0583a715534a8c981b914589a7f0dc5d60959d9ae79fb5353299a4231673d5, mrEnclave 0xfda8bb1fc9938700c25353c0a5fabc96a238e69ce8e35f08e558831a20db33a6 (geth) / 0x8f73135b83a84126c7fff37ea02f9363e134aea0f6446b13e198b20d94e75099 (reth), reportData instances 0x4777a54ff81357c966d7d98eea88f0f54d969135 / 0x292468e78605eca39071165b5eac4c9707ba9813. Receipt logs 0/1 are InstanceAdded (0xbbe529d2) ids 5 and 6 for those instances. At block 25367937 both proxies return checkLocalEnclaveReport()=true, trustedUserMrSigner(0xca0583a7...)=true, and trustedUserMrEnclave true for the respective mrEnclave (0xfda8... on 0x0ffa4a62 since setMrEnclave log 88 of source-8, block 22496504; 0x8f73... on 0x8d7c9549 since block 24798244 log 28). Root cause (source-9, source-10): _verifyParsedQuote checks the local report only against trustedUserMrEnclave/trustedUserMrSigner; the only attributes comparison (lines 206-207 / 207-208) is on the QE report (pckSignedQeReport) against the QE identity, so localEnclaveReport.attributes, and with it the DEBUG flag, is never read. A DEBUG enclave has the production MRENCLAVE but host-readable memory, so the registered instance key is extractable. Necessity of the key leak: source-11 is an RSA-3072 private key committed at raiko b3c2c1d9 (2024-05-14) and removed in e7f1f878ecc4a9b8c5151c1a1740040c3d6a54d7 (2026-06-29); openssl rsa -modulus, byte-reversed to little-endian, sha256 = 0xca0583a7..., the trusted MRSIGNER. Re-signing the production enclave with DEBUG allowed needs that key, but without the missing attribute check a DEBUG quote could not register, and a production-mode enclave does not expose its instance key; the onchain defect is necessary. Same tx: prove (0xea191743) on Inbox proxy 0x6f21c543a4af5189ebdb0723827577e1ef57ef1f passes MainnetVerifier.verifyProof with both forged SGX sub-proofs (ecrecover to the two new instances), SignalService 0x9e0a24964e5397b566c1ed39258e21ab5e35c77c log 2 saves checkpoint for block 1805600, then 11 Bridge processMessage calls set forged messages from srcChainId 167000 to RETRIABLE (logs 4-25). Earliest exercise: Etherscan txlist of every SgxVerifier emitting InstanceAdded between blocks 19773966 and 25367938 (eth_getLogs topic 0xbbe529d2...: 0xb0f3186fc1963f774f52ff455dc86aedd0b31f81, 0x7e6409e9b6c5e2064064a6cc994f9a2e95680782 and 0x9e322fc59b8f4a29e6b25c3a166ac1892aa30136 (pre-Shasta sgxGeth/sgxReth on the same two attestation proxies), 0x08568df2, 0xa1018ba2) gives 249 direct registerInstance calls; all 247 legitimate calls carry flags 0x05, none sets DEBUG. The attacker's two earlier execute txs (0xbc3a7b9b..., 0xed0ae550..., blocks 25367041/25367261) reverted. The pre-Shasta MainnetVerifier (impl 0x8c520bb75590deabc30c4fcafd8778a43e5481b9) already accepted SGX-GETH + SGX-RETH, so the dual-SGX policy is exposure, not a reset. Target history. target-1: SGX-GETH attestation ERC1967 proxy 0x0ffa4a625ed9db32b70f99180fd00759fc3e9261 created top-level in source-3 (block 22484949, index 13, creator 0x742dcfae3a8ad6e93db29349e576dfb0e035fbcf); eth_getCode empty at 22484948 for proxy and implementation; implementation 0x5e46443bd131eb6d4c6fb4849bad29af9596dd72 created in source-4 (same block, index 12). eth_getLogs Upgraded(address) topic 0xbc7cd75a... on the proxy, blocks 19700000-25367937: one event, source-3 log 70, topic1 = 0x5e46443b; EIP-1967 slot 0x360894a1... at 25367937 = 0x5e46443b. Implementation runtime keccak 0xfa42ef68dc0eb6a1fa0dd8ba97f36348246bda9d9df8334340f27f6e7a7d883f at 22484949 and 25367937. target-2: SGX-RETH attestation proxy 0x8d7c954960a36a7596d7ea4945ddf891967ca8a3 created in source-5 (block 19773966, index 37, creator 0x56706f118e42ae069f20c5636141b844d1324ae1); Upgraded history: 0xee8fc1db (19773966 log 106), 0xde1b1fbe (19844994 log 122), 0x5f73f0ad (source-7, block 19876306, index 107, log 234, sent via 0x9cbee534b5d8a6280e01a14844ee8af350399c7f); slot at 25367937 = 0x5f73f0ad; implementation created in source-6 (block 19873971), empty at 19873970, runtime keccak 0x9af19da40c21092e60782b55ec09396e674ca9197ac5b658a1ed8329037e4eeb at 19873971, 19876306 and 25367937. Both implementations lack the local-report attribute check and both SGX sub-proofs were required by the MainnetVerifier combination the attacker used, so the combination existed from target-1's activation (the later reset). Configuration review (MrSignerUpdated 0xa8796d55, MrEnclaveUpdated 0xe9c8da9c, LocalReportCheckToggled 0xcafd71da logs on both proxies to block 25367937): the only toggle is on (source-8 log 89 for target-1; 0x6a240314... block 19966171 log 107 for target-2) and narrows acceptance; MRSIGNER 0xca0583a7 was trusted at source-8 log 87 and at 19966171 log 106; no MrEnclave was ever untrusted (all events carry true), and 0x8d7c9549 held 28 trusted MRENCLAVE values before 0x8f73..., so no single configuration value is necessary to the DEBUG-acceptance condition; the intended production identities only make the verifier operational.

limitations: The exploit also required the leaked enclave signing key (offchain); admission rests on the onchain attestation defect, without which a DEBUG quote could not register.
